def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        for r in (r0,r1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in (c0,c1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    return out

for name,d in [('d1',d1),('d2',d2),('d3',d3)]:
    pred=transform(d['input'])
    diffs=[(r,c,d['output'][r][c],pred[r][c]) for r in range(len(d['input'])) for c in range(len(d['input'][0])) if pred[r][c]!=d['output'][r][c]]
    print(name,'diffs:',diffs)

import itertools
rowsX=[]
def feats_demo(d):
    g=d['input']; o=d['output']; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    accs={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg}
    rs=[r for r,c in accs]; cs=[c for r,c in accs]
    R0,R1,C0,C1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # runs in each column and row
    def runs(vals):
        out=[];s=None;p=None
        for v in vals:
            if s is None: s=p=v
            elif v==p+1: p=v
            else: out.append((s,p)); s=p=v
        if s is not None: out.append((s,p))
        return out
    colacc={c:sorted(r for r,cc in accs if cc==c) for c in range(W)}
    rowacc={r:sorted(c for cc,r2 in [(cc,r) for r,c2 in [] ] for r in []) for r in range(H)}  # placeholder
    rowacc={r:sorted(c for cc in range(W) if (r,cc) in accs for c in [cc]) for r in range(H)}
    colruns={c:runs(v) for c,v in colacc.items()}
    rowruns={r:runs(v) for r,v in rowacc.items()}
    out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg: continue
            lab = 1 if o[r][c]==2 else 0
            # column context
            ca=colacc.get(c,[]); ra=rowacc.get(r,[])
            below=[x for x in ca if x>r]; above=[x for x in ca if x<r]
            right=[x for x in ra if x>c]; left=[x for x in ra if x<c]
            dn=min(below)-r if below else 999; up=r-min(above) if above else 999
            rt=min(right)-c if right else 999; lf=c-max(left) if left else 999
            # flank run lengths (col)
            def runlen_at(line_runs, pos):
                for (s,e) in line_runs:
                    if s<=pos<=e: return e-s+1
                return 0
            uprun = runlen_at(colruns.get(c,[]), min(above)) if above else 0
            dnrun = runlen_at(colruns.get(c,[]), max(below)) if below else 0
            lfrun = runlen_at(rowruns.get(r,[]), max(left)) if left else 0
            rtrun = runlen_at(rowruns.get(r,[]), min(right)) if right else 0
            f=dict(lab=lab, perim=(r in (R0,R1) or c in (C0,C1)),
                   dn=dn,up=up,rt=rt,lf=lf,
                   uprun=uprun,dnrun=dnrun,lfrun=lfrun,rtrun=rtrun,
                   topedge=(r==R0),botedge=(r==R1),lefedge=(c==C0),rigedge=(c==C1),
                   nacc_row=len(ra),nacc_col=len(ca))
            out.append(f)
    return out
X=[]
for d in data: X+=feats_demo(d)
